segs.text: אל מלא רחמים של כ' סיון

segs.en: For the great luminary, Rabbi Yechiel Michel of Nemirov, who was martyred for the sanctification of God in the year 5408 (1648):
segs.text: להרב המאור הגדול מו"ה יחיאל מיכל דק"ק נעמרוב הגדולה שנהרג על קידוש השם בשנת ת"ח לפ"ק:
מיוסד ע"פ א"ב:
אֵל מָלֵא רַחֲמִים. שׁוֹכֵן בַּמְרוֹמִים. אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָּאִלְמִים שׁוֹמֵעַ לְשַׁוְעַת עֲגוּמִים. הַמְצֵא מְנוּחָה נְכוֹנָה עַל כַּנְפֵי הַשְּׁכִינָה:

בְּמַעֲלוֹת קְדוֹשִׁים וּטְהוֹרִים. כְּזוֹהַר הָרַקִיעַ מַזְהִירִים. אֶת נִשְׁמַת הַגִּבּוֹרִים. דּוֹרְשֵׁי קַלִּים וַחֲמוּרִים. מַנְהִיגֵי עֲדַת יְשָׁרִים. נִשְׁחָטִים כְּאֵילִים וּכְפָרִים. בָּאוּ זֵדִים אֲרוּרִים. כְּדוֹב אוֹרֵב בַּמִּסְתָּרִים. נַחֲלָתֵנוּ נֶהֶפְכָה לְזָרִים. הִשְׂבִּיעָנוּ לַעֲנָה וּמְרוֹרִים:
גְּאוֹנֵי עוֹלָם חֲסִידֵי אֶרֶץ. גוֹדְרֵי גֶדֶר וְעוֹמְדִים בַּפֶרֶץ גָּעוּ עַל כִּלָּיוֹן וָחֶרֶץ. נָמוֹגוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי אָרֶץ:
דָּוָה לִבֵּנוּ. עַל עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשֵׁנוּ. לְשֵׁמַע אֹזֶן דָּאֲבָה נַפְשֵׁנוּ. כִּי הִפְלָא יְהֹוָה אֶת מַכּוֹתֵינוּ. וְהִכָּה שֶׁבַע עַל חַטָּאתֵינוּ:
הוֹגֵי תוֹרַת יְהֹוָה לֵילוֹת וְיָמִים. דּוֹרְשֵׁי רְשׁוּמוֹת בַּחוּרִים וַחֲכָמִים. הוּשְׁלְכוּ לָאָרֶץ לְמַטָּעֵי כְרָמִים. נֶהֱפְכוּ לְדַם נְהָרוֹת וַאֲגַמִים:
וָוֵי הָעֲמוּדִים. וּמַעֲשֵׂה חִדּוּדִים. הִרְבִּיצוּ וְהֶעֱמִידוּ תַּלְמִידִים. בְּיַד בּוֹגְדִים וְשׁוֹדְדִים. הֵמָּה הָיוּ לִשְׂרֵיפַת אֵשׁ יְקוֹדִים:
זָּהִיר וְזָרִיז בְּמִצְוַת אֵל. הָאַלּוּף הַגָּאוֹן הָרַב מוהר"ר יְחִיאֵל. נָשָׂא יָדוֹ וְלִבּוֹ לָאֵל. הוֹי אֲרִיאֵל אֲרִיאֵל:
חָמִיד וְרָגִיג לְעֵילָא וּלְתַתָּא. בְּדָרֵי מַעֲלָה וּבְדָרֵי מַטָּה. גָזְרוּ רֹאשׁוֹ בְּחֶרֶב לְהוּטָה. רְאֵה יְהֹוָה חֶרְפָּתֵנוּ וְהַבִּיטָה:
טַפְסְרֵי טוֹהַר קְדוֹשֵׁי עֶלְיוֹן. צָעֲקוּ חוּצָה מַר יִבְכָּיוּן. אֵיכָה הָיוּ לְחֶרְפָּה וּלְבִזָּיוֹן. שׁוֹד וָשֶׁבֶר וְכִלָּיוֹן:
יָוָן וְקֵדָר הִסְכִּימוּ יַחַד. לַעֲקוֹר בִּיצָתָן בְּאֵימָה וָפַחַד. יְהֹוָה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד. תִּפּוֹל עֲלֵיהֶם אֵימָתָה וָפַחַד:
כָּל מַחֲמַדֵי עַיִן. קֻדְמוּ בְּכָל כְּלֵי זַיִן. שָׂמוּ לְנֶגְדָּם כְּאַיִן. וּבְלָעוּם כְּהֶרֶף עַיִן:
לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ יוֹשְׁבֵי הָעִיר. כִּי יָבֹא עֲלֵיהֶם אוֹיֵב וָצַר. דָּלוּ עֵינֵיהֶם וְצָעֲקוּ מַר. וְתִיטַב לַייָ מִשּׁוֹר פָּר:
מָסְרוּ נַפְשָׁם וּגְוִיָּתָם. מְפַרְפְּרִים הַיְּלָדִים בְּחֵיק אִמּוֹתָם. כָּלוּ חַיֵּיהֶם וְרָבּוּ אַנְחוֹתָם. נְקוֹם יְהֹוָה נִקְמָתְךָ וְנִקְמָתָם:
נְקוֹם יְהֹוָה נְקָמָה. יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה. הַטֵּל בֵּינֵיהֶם מְהוּמָה. וְהָיוּ לְבִיזָה וּלְשַׁמָּה:
סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה קָרְעוּ בַּחֲמָתָם. שָׂרְפוּהוּ וְדָרְסוּהוּ בַּהֲלִיכָתָם. לָמָה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה יִרְאָתָם. אֵין אֱלֹהִים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָם:
עוּרָה לָמָה תִישָׁן. אוּמָה בּלֹא כְּתָב וְלָשׁוֹן. פָּשְׁטוּ יַד בְּבַת אִישׁוֹן. תְּבַהֲלֵם וְתִרְדְּפֵם כִּבְנַחַל קִישׁוֹן:
פִּתְאוֹם נִקְנְסָה מִיתָה חֲמוּרָה. עַל אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן אַדִּירֵי הַתּוֹרָה. גַּם לֹא הָיְתָה לָהֶם קְבוּרָה. אֲרִיאֵל צָעֲקוּ מָרָה:
צַהֲלוּ וָרוֹנוּ הֲרוּגֵי הַקְּהִלּוֹת. כִּי נַפְשָׁם צְרוּרָה בְּעִילוּי הָעִילוֹת. לְרֵיחַ זְבָחִים וְעוֹלוֹת:
קוּמָה יְהֹוָה וְיָפוּצוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ. כִּי הוֹרַגְנוּ כָּל הַיּוֹם עָלֶיךָ. מַלְטָה נַפְשִׁי מֵרָשָׁע חַרְבֶּךָ. נְקוֹם נִקְמַת דַּם עֲבָדֶיךָ:
רְאֵה יְהֹוָה וְהַבִּיטָה. כִּי יָרַדְנוּ מַטָה מָטָה. עַל יְדֵי אוּמָה שְׁפֵלָה וְתַתָּא. וְהָיוּ לִמְשִׁסָּה וְלִמְחִתָּה:
שָׁמַיִם הוּשְׁלְכוּ לְאֶרֶץ שְׁאִיָּה. הָרַכָּה וְהָעֲנוּגָה נְכֵאָה וּצְמֵאָה. אֵיכָה יִרְדֹּפוּ אֶחָד מֵאָה. כַּפֵּר לְעַמְּךָ פֶּשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה:

תּוֹרָה תּוֹרָה חִגְרִי שַׂק וְהִתְפַּלְשִׁי בָּאֲפָרִים. אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁפַּךְ דָּמָם כַּמַּיִם הַנִּגָּרִים. קַנֵּא לְתוֹרָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר שָׂרְפוּהָ זָרִים. הַעַל אֵלֶּה תִּתְאַפַּק יוֹצֵר הָרִים. לָכֵן בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים. יַסְתִּירֵם בְּסֵתֶר כְּנָפָיו לְעוֹלָמִים. וְיִצְרוֹר בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים אֶת נִשְׁמָתָם. יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתָם. וְיָנוּחוּ בְּשָׁלוֹם עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם. וְנֹאמַר אָמֵן:
God, full of mercy, who dwells on high — there is none like You among the mighty, who hear the cry of the grieved: grant fitting rest on the wings of the Divine Presence

among the ranks of the holy and pure, who shine like the brightness of the firmament — the souls of the mighty, who studied the lighter and the weightier matters, leaders of the congregation of the upright, who were slaughtered like rams and lambs. Cursed wicked ones came, like a bear lying in ambush; our inheritance was turned over to strangers; He has sated us with wormwood and bitterness.
The geonim of the world, the pious of the land, who built fences and stood in the breach, cried out over destruction and decree; all the inhabitants of the land melted away.
Our heart is faint for the crown of our head; at the report that reached the ear, our soul grieved, for Adonoy has made our plagues extraordinary, and struck sevenfold for our sins.

Those who meditated on the Torah of Adonoy day and night, who studied its fine details — young men and sages — were cast to the ground like the planting of vineyards; they were turned into the blood of rivers and pools.

Woe for the pillars of the world and the sharp-minded scholars, who taught and raised up many students — [they fell] into the hands of traitors and plunderers; they were given over to the burning of a blazing fire.
Careful and zealous in God's commandment: the chief, the gaon, the rabbi, our teacher Rabbi Yechiel, who lifted his hand and his heart to God. Alas, Ariel, Ariel!
Beloved and cherished above and below, among the dwellers on high and the dwellers below, they cut off his head with a flashing sword. See, Adonoy, our disgrace, and look.
The captains of purity, the holy ones of the Most High, cried out in the streets, weeping bitterly: How have they become a disgrace and a scorn — plunder, ruin and destruction!
Yavan and Kedar agreed together to uproot their brood in terror and dread. Adonoy is One and His name is One; may terror and dread fall upon them.
All the delights of the eye — weapons of every kind came upon them; they were counted as nothing, and swallowed in the blink of an eye.
The inhabitants of the city did not believe that an enemy and adversary would come upon them; they raised their eyes and cried out bitterly, and it will please Adonoy more than an ox or a bull.
They gave up their lives and their bodies; the children writhed in their mothers' bosoms. Their lives were ended and their sighs multiplied. Avenge, Adonoy, Your vengeance and theirs.
Avenge, Adonoy, with vengeance; Adonoy is a man of war. Cast confusion among them, and let them become plunder and desolation.
They tore a Torah scroll in their rage, burned it and trampled it as they went. Why should the nations say, ‘Where is their fear of God?’ ‘There is no God’ is all their scheming.
Awake! Why do You sleep? A nation without script or tongue stretched out a hand against the apple of Your eye. Terrify them and pursue them as at the brook Kishon.
Suddenly a grievous death was decreed upon the cedars of Lebanon, the mighty ones of Torah; they did not even have burial. Ariel cried out bitterly.
Rejoice and sing, slain of the communities, for your souls are bound up on high above the heights, to the aroma of sacrifices and burnt offerings.
Arise, Adonoy, and let Your enemies be scattered; for we are killed all the day for Your sake. Deliver my soul from the wicked, who is Your sword. Avenge the blood of Your servants.
See, Adonoy, and look: for we have gone down lower and lower at the hands of a base and lowly nation, and they have become plunder and ruin.
The heavens were cast down to a desolate earth; the tender and delicate one is crushed and thirsty. How shall one chase a hundred? Atone for Your people's transgression and sin.

Torah, Torah, gird on sackcloth and roll in the ashes, for their blood was spilled like water poured out. Be zealous for Your Torah, which strangers burned. Will You restrain Yourself for these, Creator of mountains? Therefore may the Master of Mercy shelter them in the shelter of His wings forever, and bind their souls in the bond of life. Adonoy is their inheritance; and may they rest in peace upon their resting places. And let us say, Amen.

segs.en: Selichot for the Seventeenth of Tammuz
segs.text: סליחות לשבעה עשר בתמוז
סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי בְּרוֹב אִוַּלְתֵּנוּ שָׁגִינוּ מְחַל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי רַבּוּ עֲוֹנֵינוּ:

אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם אַתָּה וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים נִקְרֵאתָ. וְדֶרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה הוֹרֵיתָ. גְּדֻלַּת רַחֲמֶיךָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ תִּזְכֹּר הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם לְזֶרַע יְדִידֶיךָ. תֵּפֶן אֵלֵינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים כִּי אַתָּה הוּא בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים. בְּתַחֲנוּן וּבִתְפִלָּה פָּנֶיךָ נְקַדֵּם. כְּהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּדֶם. מֵחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ שׁוּב כְּמוֹ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָָ כָּתוּב. וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ נֶחֱסֶה וְנִתְלוֹנָן כְּיוֹם וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן. תַּעֲבֹר עַל פֶּשַׁע וְתִמְחֶה אָשָׁם. כְּיוֹם וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם. תַּאֲזִין שַׁוְעָתֵנוּ וְתַקְשִׁיב מֶנּוּ מַאֲמַר. כְּיוֹם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:
וַיַּעֲבוֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא:

יְהֹוָה, יְהֹוָה, אֵל, רַחוּם, וְחַנּוּן, אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם, וְרַב חֶסֶד, וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים, נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן, וָפֶשַׁע, וְחַטָּאָה, וְנַקֵּה: וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ מְחַל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶיךָ:

אַל תִּתְּנוּ דֳמִי לוֹ עַד יְכוֹנֵן וְעַד יָשִׂים אֶת יְרוּשָׁלַיִם תְּהִלָּה בָּאָרֶץ: כִּי עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה אוֹר: אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹשְׁנוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂינוּ וְנִכְלַמְנוּ בַּעֲוֹנֵינוּ:

כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים כֵּן תְּרַחֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֵינוּ: לַיהֹוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶךָ סֶּלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בּוֹטֵחַ בָּךְ: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ:

parts.text: סְלַח נָא לַעֲוֹן הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּגֹדֶל חַסְדֶּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתָ לָעָם הַזֶּה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הֵנָּה וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

segs.text: הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁמָע פְּקַח עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה שׁוֹמְמוֹתֵינוּ וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלֶיהָ כִּי לֹא עַל צִדְקוֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי עַל רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים: אֲדֹנָי שְׁמָעָה אֲדֹנָי סְלָחָה אֲדֹנָי הַקְשִׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל תְּאַחַר לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהַי כִּי שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל עִירְךָ וְעַל עַמֶּךָ:
סליחה מיוסד ע"פ א"ב:
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ:

אָתָאנוּ לְךָ יוֹצֵר רוּחוֹת. בְּרוֹב עֲוֹנֵינוּ כָּבְדוּ אֲנָחוֹת. גְּזֵרוֹת עָצְמוּ וְרַבּוּ צְרִיחוֹת. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז נִשְׁתַּבְּרוּ הַלּוּחוֹת: גָּלִינוּ מִבֵּית הַבְּחִירָה. דִּינֵנוּ נֶחְתַּם וְנִגְזְרָה גְּזֵרָה. וְחָשַׁךְ בַּעֲדֵנוּ אוֹרָה. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז נִשְׂרְפָה הַתּוֹרָה: הָרְסוּ אוֹיְבֵינוּ הַהֵיכָל. וּבָרְחָה שְׁכִינָה מִזָּוִית הֵיכָל. וְנִמְסַרְנוּ בִּידֵי זֵדִים לְהִתְאַכָּל. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז הָעֳמַד צֶלֶם בְּהֵיכָל: זֵרוּנוּ מֵעִיר אֶל עִיר. וְנִלְכַּד מֶנּוּ רַב וְצָעִיר. חָרְבָה עִירֵנוּ וְאֵשׁ בָּהּ הִבְעִיר. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז הָבְקְעָה הָעִיר: טָפַשׁ בְּמִקְדָּשֵׁנוּ צַר הַמַּשְׁמִיד. וְנֻטַּל מֵחָתָן וְכַלָּה אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד. יַעַן כִּעַסְנוּךָ נִתַּנּוּ לְהַשְׁמִיד. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז בֻּטַּל הַתָּמִיד: כָּלָה מֶנּוּ כָּל הוֹד וָשֶׁבַח. חַרְבּוֹ שָׁלַף אוֹיֵב עָלֵינוּ לָאֶבַח. לִהְיוֹת עוֹלְלִים וְיוֹנְקִים מוּכָנִים לַטֶּבַח. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז בָּטְלוּ עוֹלָה וָזָבַח: מָרַדְנוּ לְשׁוֹכֵן מְעוֹנוֹת. לָכֵן נִתְפַּזַּרְנוּ בְּכָל פִּנּוֹת. נֶהְפַּךְ מְחוֹלֵנוּ לְקִינוֹת. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז בָּטְלוּ קָרְבָּנוֹת: סָרַרְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ מֵרִיב לְשׁוֹנוֹת. לָכֵן לָמְדָה לְשׁוֹנֵנוּ לוֹמַר קִינוֹת. עֻזַּבְנוּ בְּלִי לְהִמָּנוֹת. כִּי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז גָּרְמוּ לָנוּ עֲוֹנוֹת: פֻּזַּרְנוּ בְּלִי מְצוֹא רְוָחָה. לָכֵן רָבְתָה בָּנוּ אֲנָחָה. צוּר רְאֵה נַפְשֵׁנוּ כִּי שָׁחָה. וְשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז הֲפָךְ לָנוּ לְשָׂשׂוֹן וּלְשִׂמְחָה: קִשִּׁינוּ עֹרֶף וְרָבְתָה בָנוּ אָסוֹן. לָכֵן נִתַּנּוּ לִמְשִׁסָּה וְרִפְשׁוֹן. רְאֵה יְהֹוָה וְחַלְּצֵנוּ מֵאָסוֹן. וְשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז הֲפָךְ לָנוּ לְשִׂמְחָה וּלְשָׂשׂוֹן: שְׁעֵנוּ שֹׁכֵן רוּמָה. וְקַבֵּץ נְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ מִקַּצְווֹת אֲדָמָה. תֹּאמַר לְצִיּוֹן קוּמָה. וְשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בְּתַמּוּז הֲפָךְ לָנוּ לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָה וְנֶחָמָה:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים מִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן, מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לְחַטָּאִים וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים, עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל בָּשָׂר וָרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם תִּגְמוֹל, אֵל הוֹרֵיתָ לָּנוּ לוֹמַר שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, וּזְכָר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּדֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם, וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה:
וַיַּעֲבוֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא:

יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה: וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ מְחַל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶיךָ:
אֱלֹהִים אַל דֳּמִי לָךְ אַל תֶּחֱרַשׁ וְאַל תִּשְׁקוֹט אֵל: כִּי הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ: אֵל נְקָמוֹת יְהֹוָה אֵל נְקָמוֹת הוֹפִיעַ:

כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים כֵּן תְּרַחֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֵינוּ: לַיהֹוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶךָ סֶּלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בּוֹטֵחַ בָּךְ: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ:

segs.en: Selichah based on Aleph-Bet and the name of the author Menachem bar Rabbi Meir:
segs.text: סליחה מיוסד ע"פ א"ב ושם המחבר מנחם ברבי מכיר:
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ

אֲמָרֵר בְּבֶכִי מִפְּנֵי יָד שְׁלוּחָה בְּעִי. בְּנַאֲצִי בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ בְּבִגְדִי וְקָבְעִי. גָּז וּבָרַח וְנָסַע עֶשֶׂר וְעָלָה לַשְּׁבִיעִי. דִּמַּנִי הִצִּיקַנִי הִסִּיקַנִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִי: הֵבִיא מוֹעֵד בִּמְלֵאָתוֹ לִשְׁבּוֹר בַּחוּרֵי גִמּוּז. וְרִבָּה בוֹ פַעֲמַיִם בְּמִסְמוּס וּמִזְמוּז. זְבוּלוֹ כְּשָׁר שַׁאֲנַנּוֹת מְבַכּוֹת אֶת הַתַּמּוּז. חִיְּבַנִי אִיְּבַנִי אֲזַי בְּיֶרַח תַּמּוּז: טָמְנוּ פַחִים חֲמִשָּׁה בְּמִקְרָא תְּלָאוֹת מְשֻׁלָּחוֹת. יָכְלוּ לִי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר בּוֹ בַּאֲלִיחוֹת. כִּי נוֹקַשְׁתִּי כְּכַלָּה עֲלוּבָה בְּחֻפַּת שַׁלְוָה וְהַצְלָחוֹת. לְרוֹעִי לֹא הִמְתַּנְתִּי שֵׁשׁ וְנִשְׁתַּבְּרוּ הַלֻּחוֹת: מִיָּדוֹ עָדִיתִי חֳלִי וָכֶתֶם אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד. נִגָּרוֹת בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ כְּשִׁחַתִּי דְרָכָי לְהַשְׁמִיד. סֵדֶר עֲבוֹדָתוֹ וְקַיִץ מִזְבְּחוֹ קַצְתִּי לְהַעֲמִיד. עַל כֵּן מִלִּשְׁכַּת הַטְּלָאִים בֻּטַּל הַתָּמִיד: פּוֹר הִתְפּוֹרְרָה וְנִתְפַּזְּרָה סוֹעֲרָה עֲנִיָּה. צִיָּה נִמְשְׁלָה מִבְּלִי חוֹבֵל וְנִטְרְפָה כָּאֳנִיָּה. קַחְתָּהּ בְּחַטָּאתָהּ בְּרֹאשָׁהּ וּבְכֶפֶל תַּאֲנִיָּה וַאֲנִיָּה. רִיבוּהָ צָרֶיהָ כְּהַיּוֹם וְהָבְקְעָה הָעִיר בַּשְּׁנִיָּה: שֻׁלְּחָה כִּצְבִי מֻדָּח מֵאֵין דּוֹרֵשׁ לְהַסְתִּירָה. שָׁנְנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם וּנְתָנוּהָ כְּשֶׂה צַמְרָהּ וְחֶלְבָּהּ לְהַתִּירָהּ. תִּצְעַק עַל כְּלִי חֶמְדָּה שֶׁבּוֹ נִכְתָּרָה. תַּחֲמוּד עֵינֶיהָ נֻצַּל כְּשָׂרַף אַפּוֹסְטְמוֹס הַתּוֹרָה: חֵרֵף עֲשׁוּקִים וּרְצוּצִים בַּעֲבוּר הַרְעִימָם סָכָל. יְרוּדִים בִּוְהָיָה לֶאֱכוֹל וּבְהַסְתֵּר פָּנִים מִלְּהִסְתַּכָּל. יָד הִשְׁלִים מִכְּנַף שִׁקּוּצִים נֶאֱכָל. עֵת צָרָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּס וְהָעֲמַד צֶלֶם בְּהֵיכָל: דְּווּיִם סְגוּפִים בָּנִים הֶהָיוּ מִקֶּדֶם רִאשׁוֹנִים. סְמוּכוֹת צָרוֹתֵיהֶם זוֹ לְזוֹ כַּמָּה שָׁנִים. לוֹקִים כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂינָה הַדְּבוֹרִים וְהָעַקְרַבִּים שׁוֹנִים. הוֹגִים אָבַד שִׂבְרָם וּבָטֵל סִכּוּיָם בְּאִישׁוֹנִים: אֵל קַנָּא בְּהִתְאַפֵּק בְּמַקְנִיאֶיךָ דְּשֵׁנִים רְטוּבִים. מְחַכִּים תָּקִים עוֹמְדִים לְעוֹלָמִים. כִּנְטִיעִים מְחֻטָּבִים בַּאֲהָבִים. הָאֱמֶת וְהַשָּׁלוֹם בְּצוֹמוֹת חֲטוּבִים. נֶצַח הֱיוֹתָם לְשִׂמְחָה וּלְשָׂשׂוֹן וּלְמוֹעֲדִים טוֹבִים:

אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים מִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן, מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לְחַטָּאִים וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים, עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל בָּשָׂר וָרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם תִּגְמוֹל, אֵל הוֹרֵיתָ לָּנוּ לוֹמַר שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, וּזְכָר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּדֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם, וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה:
וַיַּעֲבוֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא:

יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה: וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ מְחַל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶיךָ:

parts.en: Refrain, name of the author Shlomo (and based on the meter of a stake and two movements, and a stake and two movements)
parts.text: <b><b><small>פזמון שם המחבר שלמה <small>(ומיוסד במשקל יתד ושני תנועות ויתד ושני תנועות)</small>

שְׁעֵה נֶאֱסַר. אֲשֶׁר נִמְסַר. בְּיַד בָּבֶל וְגַם שֵׂעִיר. לְךָ יֶהֱמֶה זֶה כַּמֶּה וְיִתְחַנֵּן כְּבֶן צָעִיר. יוֹם גָּבַר הָאוֹיֵב וַתִּבָּקַע הָעִיר: לְזֹאת אִכַּף. וְאֶסְפּוֹק כַּף. בְּיוֹם חִמֵּשׁ פִּזְרוֹנִי. וְעַל רֶגֶל הָעֵגֶל הַלּוּחוֹת יְצָאוּנִי. וְגַם הִשְׁמִיד הַתָּמִיד וּבַסּוּגַר הֱבִיאַנִי. וְהוּשַׂם אֱלִיל בְּהֵיכַל כְּלִיל וּמֵעֲצָתוֹ כְּלָאַנִי. וְהַמִּנְחָה הוּנָחָה וְדָתְךָ צָר בָּאֵשׁ הִבְעִיר.

מְאֹד אֶתְחַל וָאֶתְחַלְחַל בְּיוֹם שַׁדַּי דְּחָפַנִי. וְהַשְּׁפִיפוֹן מִצָּפוֹן כְּשִׁבּוֹלֶת שְׁטָפַנִי. מְאוֹר חָשַׁךְ וְגַם שֵׁשַׁךְ כְּמוֹ כַּדּוּר צְנָפַנִי. וְהַצַּיָּד שָׁלַח יָד וְהַצָּפִיר וְהַשָּׂעִיר.

הוֹד לִבִּי וּמִשְׂגַּבִּי הֲלָעַד אַפְּךָ יֶעֱשַׁן. הֲלֹא תִרְאֶה עַם נִלְאֶה אֲשֶׁר הָשְׁחַר כְּמוֹ כִּבְשָׁן. גְּדוֹר פִּרְצִי בְּבֶן פַּרְצִי. וּמֵחֶדֶק לְקוֹט שׁוֹשָׁן. בְּנֵה בֵּית זְבוּל לְהָשִׁיב גְּבוּל. הַכַּרְמֶל וְהַבָּשָׁן. וְעַיִן פְּקַח וְנָקָם קַח מֵאֵצֶר וּמִדִּישָׁן. שְׁפוֹט אִלֵּם וְאָז יְשַׁלֵּם הַמַּבְעֶה וְהַמַּבְעִיר. יוֹם גָּבַר הָאוֹיֵב וַתִּבָּקַע הָעִיר:

segs.text: אֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים מִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן, מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לְחַטָּאִים וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים, עֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל בָּשָׂר וָרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם תִּגְמוֹל, אֵל הוֹרֵיתָ לָּנוּ לוֹמַר שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, וּזְכָר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, כְּהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּדֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם, וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה:
וַיַּעֲבוֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא:

יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה: וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ מְחַל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶיךָ:

זְכוֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ יְהֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה: זָכְרֵנוּ יְהֹוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָקְדֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ: זְכוֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ: זְכוֹר יְהֹוָה חִבַּת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם אַהֲבַת צִיּוֹן אַל תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ כִּי בָא מוֹעֵד: זְכוֹר יְהֹוָה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָיִם הָאוֹמְרִים עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְּסוֹד בָּהּ: זְכוֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְכָל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם וְנָחֲלוּ לְעוֹלָם: זְכוֹר לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאֶל רִשְׁעוֹ וְאֶל חַטָּאתוֹ:
זְכוֹר לָנוּ בְּרִית אָבוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכּוֹר וְהָאָרֶץ אֶזְכּוֹר:

זְכוֹר לָנוּ בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה: עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ כְּמָה שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּנוּ וְאַף גַּם זֹאת בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אוֹיְבֵיהֶם לֹא מְאַסְתִּים וְלֹא גְעַלְתִּים לְכַלּוֹתָם לְהָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם: הָשֵׁב שְׁבוּתֵנוּ וְרַחֲמֵנוּ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב וְשָׁב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְךָ וְרִחֲמֶךָ וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה: קַבֵּץ נִדָּחֵינוּ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶךָ: מְחֵה פְשָׁעֵינוּ כָּעָב וְכֶעָנָן כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב מָחִיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאתֶיךָ שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּיךָ: מְחֵה פְשָׁעֵינוּ לְמַעַנְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מוֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶיךָ לְמַעֲנִי וְחַטֹּאתֶיךָ לֹא אֶזְכּוֹר: הַלְבֵּן חֲטָאֵינוּ כַּשֶּׁלֶג וְכַצֶּמֶר כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב. לְכוּ נָא וְנִוָּכְחָה יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אִם יִהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים כַּשֶּׁלֶג יַלְבִּינוּ. אִם יַאְדִּימוּ כַתּוֹלָע כַּצֶּמֶר יִהְיוּ: זְרוֹק עָלֵינוּ מַיִם טְהוֹרִים וְטַהֲרֵנוּ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב. וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַיִם טְהוֹרִים וּטְהַרְתֶּם מִכֹּל טֻמְאֹתֵיכֶם וּמִכָּל גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם אֲטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם: רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְאַל תַּשְׁחִיתֵנוּ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב. כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶךָ וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת בְּרִית אֲבֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם: מוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב וּמָל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת לְבַב זַרְעֶךָ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁךָ לְמַעַן חַיֶּיךָ: הִמָּצֵא לָנוּ בְּבַקָּשָׁתֵנוּ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם מִשָּׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמָצָאתָ כִּי תִדְרְשֶׁנוּ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל נַפְשֶׁךָ: תְּבִיאֵנוּ אֶל הַר קָדְשֶׁךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בְּבֵית תְּפִלָּתֶךָ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב וַהֲבִיאוֹתִים אֶל הַר קָדְשִׁי וְשִׂמַּחְתִּים בְּבֵית תְּפִלָּתִי עוֹלוֹתֵיהֶם וְזִבְחֵיהֶם לְרָצוֹן עַל מִזְבְּחִי כִּי בֵיתִי בֵּית תְּפִלָּה יִקָּרֵא לְכָל הָעַמִּים:

שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם: אֲמָרֵינוּ הַאֲזִינָה יְהֹוָה בִּינָה הֲגִיגֵנוּ: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִינוּ וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבֵּנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרֵנוּ וְגוֹאֲלֵנוּ: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנוּ מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל תִּקַּח מִמֶּנּוּ: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנוּ לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחֵנוּ אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ: אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ, אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנוּ: עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ אוֹת לְטוֹבָה, וְיִרְאוּ שׂוֹנְאֵינוּ וְיֵבוֹשׁוּ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה עֲזַרְתָּנוּ וְנִחַמְתָּנוּ: כִּי לְךָ יְהֹוָה הוֹחָלְנוּ, אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. תָּבֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵנוּ שֶׁאֵין אָנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָאנוּ אֲבָל אֲנַחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ חָטָאנוּ:

אָשַׁמְנוּ. בָּגַדְנוּ. גָּזַלְנוּ. דִּבַּרְנוּ דֹּפִי: הֶעֱוִינוּ. וְהִרְשַׁעְנוּ. זַדְנוּ. חָמַסְנוּ. טָפַלְנוּ שֶׁקֶר: יָעַצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּבְנוּ. לַצְנוּ. מָרַדְנוּ. נִאַצְנוּ. סָרַרְנוּ. עָוִינוּ. פָּשַׁעְנוּ. צָרַרְנוּ. קִשִּׁינוּ עֹרֶף: רָשַׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַתְנוּ. תִּעַבְנוּ. תָּעִינוּ. תִּעְתָּעְנוּ:

סַרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֹא שָׁוָה לָנוּ: וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲנַחְנוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ: הִרְשַׁעְנוּ וּפָשַׁעְנוּ לָכֵן לֹא נוֹשָׁעְנוּ וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּנוּ לַעֲזוֹב דֶּרֶךְ רֶשַׁע וְחִישׁ לָנוּ יֶשַׁע: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ יַעֲזוֹב רָשָׁע דַּרְכּוֹ וְאִישׁ אָוֶן מַחְשְׁבוֹתָיו וְיָשׁוֹב אֶל יְהֹוָה וִירַחֲמֵהוּ וְאֶל אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּי יַרְבֶּה לִסְלוֹחַ: מְשִׁיחַ צִדְקֶךָ אָמַר לְפָנֶיךָ. שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי יָבִין מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּנִי:נַקֵּנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִכָּל פְּשָׁעֵינוּ וְטַהֲרֵנוּ מִכָּל טֻמְאוֹתֵינוּ וּזְרוֹק עָלֵינוּ מַיִם טְהוֹרִים וְטַהֲרֵנוּ כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַיִם טְהוֹרִים וּטְהַרְתֶּם מִכֹּל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִכָּל גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם אֲטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם: עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ רְעֵבֵי טוּבְךָ צְמֵאֵי חַסְדֶּךָ תְּאֵבֵי יִשְׁעֶךָ. יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִיחוֹת:

אֵל רַחוּם שְׁמֶךָ. אֵל חַנּוּן שְׁמֶךָ. בָּנוּ נִקְרָא שְׁמֶךָ. יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ: עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן אֲמִתֶּךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן בְּרִיתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן גָּדְלְךָ וְתִפְאַרְתֶּךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן דָּתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן הוֹדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן וִעוּדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן זִכְרֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן טוּבֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יִחוּדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן כְּבוֹדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן לִמּוּדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן מַלְכוּתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן נִצְחֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן סוֹדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן עֻזֶּךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן פְּאֵרֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן צִדְקָתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָׁתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁכִינָתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תְּהִלָּתֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן אוֹהֲבֶיךָ שׁוֹכְנֵי עָפָר. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן דָּוִד וּשְׁלֹמֹה. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שִׁמְמוֹת הֵיכָלֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן הֲרִיסוּת מִזְבְּחֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן הֲרוּגִים עַל שֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן טְבוּחִים עַל יִחוּדֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן בָּאֵי בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּיִם עַל קִדּוּשׁ שְׁמֶךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יוֹנְקֵי שָׁדַיִם שֶׁלֹּא חָטְאוּ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן גְּמוּלֵי חָלָב שֶׁלֹּא פָּשְׁעוּ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תִּינוֹקוֹת שֶׁל בֵּית רַבָּן. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ אִם לֹא לְמַעֲנֵנוּ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ:

עֲנֵנוּ יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ אָבִינוּ עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ בּוֹרְאֵנוּ עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ גּוֹאֲלֵנוּ עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ דּוֹרְשֵׁנוּ עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ וָתִיק וְחָסִיד עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ זַךְ וְיָשָׁר עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ חַי וְקַיָּם עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ טוֹב וּמֵטִיב עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ יוֹדֵעַ יֶצֶר עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ כּוֹבֵשׁ כְּעָסִים עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ לוֹבֵשׁ צְדָקוֹת עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ נוֹרָא וְנִשְׂגָּב עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ סוֹלֵחַ וּמוֹחֵל עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ עוֹנֶה בְּעֵת צָרָה עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ רַחוּם וְחַנוּן עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ שׁוֹמֵעַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִים עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ תּוֹמֵךְ תְּמִימִים עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ פַּחַד יִצְחָק עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ עֶזְרַת הַשְּׁבָטִים עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ מִשְׂגַּב אִמָּהוֹת עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ רַךְ לִרְצוֹת עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ עוֹנֶה בְּעֵת רָצוֹן עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ דַּיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת עֲנֵנוּ:

מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיִצְחָק בְּנוֹ כְּשֶׁנֶּעֱקַד עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיַעֲקֹב בְּבֵית אֵל הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיוֹסֵף בְּבֵית הָאֲסוּרִים הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ עַל יַם סוּף הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְמֹשֶׁה בְּחוֹרֵב הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְאַהֲרֹן בַּמַּחְתָּה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְפִינְחָס בְּקוּמוֹ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לִשְׁמוּאֵל בַּמִּצְפָּה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְדָוִד וּשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְאֵלִיָּהוּ בְּהַר הַכַּרְמֶל הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לֶאֱלִישָׁע בִּירִיחוֹ הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיוֹנָה בִּמְעֵי הַדָּגָה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְחִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה בְּחָלְיוֹ הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לַחֲנַנְיָה מִישָׁאֵל וַעֲזַרְיָה בְּתוֹךְ כִּבְשַׁן הָאֵשׁ הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְדָנִיאֵל בְּגוֹב הָאֲרָיוֹת הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְמָרְדְּכַי וְאֶסְתֵּר בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְעֶזְרָא בַּגּוֹלָה הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ. מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְכָל הַצַּדִּיקִים וְהַחֲסִידִים וְהַתְּמִימִים וְהַיְּשָׁרִים הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ:

רַחֲמָנָא דְעָנֵי לַעֲנִיֵי עֲנֵינָא. רַחֲמָנָא דְעָנֵי לִתְבִירֵי לִבָּא עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא דְעָנֵי לְמַכִּיכֵי רוּחָא עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא חוּס. רַחֲמָנָא פְּרוֹק. רַחֲמָנָא שְׁזִיב. רַחֲמָנָא רְחַם עֲלָן. הַשְׁתָּא בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב:
Forgive us, our Father, for in our great folly we have erred; pardon us, our King, for our iniquities are many.

You are a God slow to anger, and You are called the Master of Mercy. You showed us the way of repentance. May the greatness of Your mercy and Your kindness be remembered today and every day for the offspring of Your beloved ones. Turn to us with compassion, for You are the Master of Mercy. With supplication and prayer we approach Your presence, as You made known to the humble one (Moses) of old. Turn back from Your fierce anger, as is written in Your Torah. In the shadow of Your wings we take refuge and find shelter, as on the day when “Adonoy descended in a cloud.” Pass over transgression and wipe away guilt, as on the day when “He stood with him there.” Hear our cry and heed our words, as on the day when “He proclaimed the name of Adonoy,” and it was said:
And Adonoy passed before him and proclaimed:

“Adonoy, Adonoy, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving. Pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance. Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You, Adonoy, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You.”

“Give Him no rest until He establishes and until He makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.” For with You is the source of life; by Your light we see light. Our God, we are ashamed of our deeds and humiliated by our iniquities.

As a father has compassion on his children, so may Adonoy have compassion on us. Salvation belongs to Adonoy; Your blessing is upon Your people, Selah. Adonoy of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our refuge, Selah. Adonoy of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. Adonoy, save! May the King answer us on the day we call.
Pardon, please, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of Your kindness, and as You have forgiven this people from Egypt until now; and there it was said:
And Adonoy said, “I have pardoned, as you have asked.”

Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolation and the city upon which Your name is called, for not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercy. Adonoy, hear! Adonoy, forgive! Adonoy, attend and act, do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and Your people.
Our God and God of our fathers:

We have come to You, Creator of spirits. Through our many sins our sighs have grown heavy; decrees grew mighty and cries multiplied; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz the tablets were broken. We were exiled from the chosen House; our verdict was sealed and a decree decreed; its light was darkened for us; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz the Torah was burned. Our enemies razed the Temple; the Presence fled from the corner of the Sanctuary; we were handed over to the wicked to be devoured; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz an idol was set up in the Sanctuary. We were scattered from city to city; great and small among us were captured; our city was ruined and fire was kindled in it; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz the city was breached. The destroying foe was insolent in our Sanctuary and took from groom and bride bracelet and band; because we angered You we were given to destruction; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz the daily offering ceased. All splendor and praise ended among us; the enemy drew his sword against us to strike; infants and nursing babes were made ready for slaughter; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz burnt offering and sacrifice ceased. We rebelled against the One who dwells on high; therefore we were scattered to every corner; our dancing turned into lamentations; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz the offerings ceased. We rebelled before You with quarrelsome tongues; therefore our tongue learned to say lamentations; we were abandoned without number; for on the seventeenth of Tamuz our sins brought it upon us. We were scattered without finding relief; therefore sighing increased among us; Rock, see that our soul is bowed down; and may the seventeenth of Tamuz be turned for us into joy and gladness. We stiffened our necks and disaster multiplied among us; therefore we were given to plunder and mire; see, Adonoy, and rescue us from disaster; and may the seventeenth of Tamuz be turned for us into gladness and joy. Turn to us, You who dwell on high, and gather our scattered ones from the ends of the earth; say to Zion, “Arise”; and may the seventeenth of Tamuz be turned for us into a day of salvation and comfort.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Adonoy descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Adonoy.”
And Adonoy passed before him and proclaimed:

“Adonoy, Adonoy, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving. Pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance. Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You, Adonoy, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You.”

“God, do not keep silence; do not be silent and do not be still, O God. For behold, Your enemies are in tumult, and those who hate You have lifted up their heads.” “God of vengeance, Adonoy, God of vengeance, shine forth!”

As a father has compassion on his children, so may Adonoy have compassion on us. Salvation belongs to Adonoy; Your blessing is upon Your people, Selah. Adonoy of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our refuge, Selah. Adonoy of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. Adonoy, save! May the King answer us on the day we call.
Our God and God of our fathers:

I will weep bitterly because of the hand stretched out against me; the blasphemer in his house, in my garments and my vessels; he sheared and fled, traveled ten and went up to the seventh; he crushed me, distressed me and set me ablaze in the fourth month. He brought the appointed time, at its fulfillment, to break my chosen young men; and he repeatedly ravaged and crushed in it; those who dwelt at ease weep for Tammuz; he made me guilty and made me his enemy then, in the month of Tamuz. Five snares were hidden in Scripture, troubles sent. They prevailed against me on the seventeenth of it; for I was ensnared like a wretched bride under the canopy of tranquility and prosperity. I did not wait for my Shepherd six hours, and the tablets were broken. From His hand I was adorned with jewel and gold, bracelet and band; they were poured out on the day of His anger when I corrupted my ways, to destroy. I grew weary of establishing His order of service and the summer-fruit of His altar; therefore, from the Chamber of the Lambs the daily offering ceased. She crumbled and was scattered, storm-tossed and poor; likened to a desert, like a ship without a pilot, torn apart. She took upon her head, for her sin, double mourning and lament. Her foes multiplied against her, as on this day, and the city was breached in the second [Temple]. She was sent away like a hunted gazelle, with no one to seek to hide her. They sharpened their tongues and gave her over like a sheep, her wool and fat made permissible. She cries out over the precious vessels with which she was crowned; her eyes long for rescue, as the wicked Apostemos burned the Torah. He reproached the oppressed and crushed, for the foolish one provoked them; brought low, they ate in emptiness, and in the hiding of the face could not look. The hand was devoured by the wing of abominations: a time of trouble, when the idol was set up in the Sanctuary. Sick and afflicted were the children of old, the first. Their troubles followed one upon another for several years; they were struck as bees and scorpions do, in various ways; they ponder how their hope perished and their expectation ceased. Jealous God, restraining Yourself toward those who are zealous for You, fat and fresh, who wait, may You establish them to stand forever, like saplings cut with love; truth and peace in carved-out fasts; may they be forever for gladness and joy and good festivals.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Adonoy descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Adonoy.”
And Adonoy passed before him and proclaimed:

“Adonoy, Adonoy, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving. Pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance. Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You, Adonoy, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You.”

Look upon the captive, who was delivered into the hand of Babylon and also Seir; he moans to You, and for how long, pleading like a youngster. The day the enemy prevailed and the city was breached. For this I strike my palm; on the fifth day they scattered me; because of the calf the tablets left me; the daily offering was destroyed and I was brought into confinement; an idol was set up in the Sanctuary, completely, and by his counsel confined me; the meal offering was left, and the foe burned Your law with fire. I tremble and writhe greatly on the day the Almighty pushed me; the serpent from the north swept me away like a flood; the light grew dark and was hidden, and wrapped me like a ball; the hunter stretched out his hand, the he-goat and the goat. My heart's glory and my refuge, will Your anger smoke forever? Do You not see a weary people, to whom the dawn is like a furnace? Wall up my breaches, and take the lily; build the house of habitation, to restore the border, Carmel and Bashan. Open an eye and take vengeance from storehouse and granary. Judge the dumb, and then the burner will repay the one who kindled the fire. The day the enemy prevailed and the city was breached.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Adonoy descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Adonoy.”
And Adonoy passed before him and proclaimed:

“Adonoy, Adonoy, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving. Pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance. Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You, Adonoy, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You.”

Remember Your compassion, Adonoy, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. Remember us, Adonoy, with the favor You show Your people; visit us with Your salvation. Remember Your congregation, which You acquired long ago, the tribe of Your inheritance that You redeemed, this Mount Zion where You have dwelt. Remember, Adonoy, the love of Jerusalem and the affection for Zion; do not forget them forever. You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to be gracious to her, for the appointed time has come. Remember, Adonoy, against the children of Edom the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Strip it, strip it, to its very foundation.” Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel, Your servants, to whom You swore by Yourself and said to them, “I will multiply your offspring like the stars of heaven, and all this land of which I have spoken I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.” Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin.

Remember for us the covenant of the fathers, as You said: “I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham I will remember, and I will remember the land.”

Remember for us the covenant of the first ones, as You said: “I will remember for them the covenant of the first ones, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, to be their God; I am Adonoy.” Do with us as You have promised: “Even this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them nor abhor them, to destroy them and to break My covenant with them, for I am Adonoy their God.” Bring back our captives and have compassion on us, as it is written: “Adonoy your God will return your captivity and have compassion on you, and He will again gather you from all the peoples among whom Adonoy your God has scattered you.” Gather our dispersed, as it is written: “If your dispersed are at the ends of the heavens, from there Adonoy your God will gather you, and from there He will take you.” Wipe away our transgressions like a cloud and like a mist, as it is written: “I have wiped away your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like a mist; return to Me, for I have redeemed you.” Wipe away our transgressions for Your own sake, as You said: “I, I am He who wipes away your transgressions for My own sake, and your sins I will not remember.” Make our sins white as snow and as wool, as it is written: “‘Come now, let us reason together,’ says Adonoy. ‘If your sins are like scarlet, they will be white as snow; if they are red as crimson, they will be like wool.’” Sprinkle pure water upon us and purify us, as it is written: “I will sprinkle pure water upon you, and you will be purified; from all your impurities and from all your idols I will purify you.” Have compassion on us and do not destroy us, as it is written: “For Adonoy your God is a compassionate God; He will not fail you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers that He swore to them.” Circumcise our hearts to love Your name, as it is written: “Adonoy your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring, to love Adonoy your God with all your heart and all your soul, that you may live.” Let us find You when we seek You, as it is written: “From there you will seek Adonoy your God, and you will find Him, when you search for Him with all your heart and all your soul.” Bring us to Your holy mountain and make us joyful in Your house of prayer, as it is written: “I will bring them to My holy mountain and make them joyful in My house of prayer; their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”

Hear our voice, Adonoy our God; spare us and have compassion on us, and accept our prayer with compassion and favor. Bring us back to You, Adonoy, and we shall return; renew our days as of old. Give ear to our words, Adonoy; consider our meditation. May the words of our mouths and the meditation of our hearts be acceptable before You, Adonoy, our Rock and our Redeemer. Do not cast us away from before You, and do not take Your holy spirit from us. Do not cast us away in old age; when our strength fails, do not forsake us. Do not forsake us, Adonoy our God; do not be far from us. Show us a sign for good, that those who hate us may see it and be ashamed, for You, Adonoy, have helped us and comforted us. For in You, Adonoy, we have hoped; You will answer, my Lord our God.

Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before You, and do not hide Yourself from our plea, for we are not so brazen and stiff-necked as to say before You, Adonoy our God and God of our fathers, that we are righteous and have not sinned; but indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.

We have been guilty, we have betrayed, we have robbed, we have spoken slander. We have acted perversely, and we have done wickedly; we have acted willfully, we have done violence, we have accused falsely. We have counseled evil, we have lied, we have scoffed, we have rebelled, we have provoked, we have turned away, we have committed iniquity, we have transgressed, we have oppressed, we have been stiff-necked. We have acted wickedly, we have corrupted, we have done abominations, we have gone astray, and we have led others astray.

We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and it has not profited us. And You are righteous in all that has come upon us, for You have acted truthfully, and we have been wicked. We have been wicked and have transgressed, therefore we have not been saved; put it in our hearts to forsake the way of wickedness, and hasten salvation for us, as is written by Your prophet: “Let the wicked forsake his way and the man of iniquity his thoughts, and let him return to Adonoy and He will have compassion on him, and to our God, for He will abundantly pardon.” Your righteous anointed one said before You: “Who can discern errors? Cleanse me from hidden faults.” Cleanse us, Adonoy our God, from all our transgressions and purify us from all our impurities, and sprinkle clean water upon us and purify us, as is written by Your prophet: “I will sprinkle clean water upon you and you shall be clean; from all your impurities and from all your idols I will cleanse you.” Your people and Your inheritance, hungry for Your goodness, thirsty for Your kindness, longing for Your salvation: let them recognize and know that to Adonoy our God belong mercies and forgiveness.

Your name is a compassionate God; Your name is a gracious God; Your name is called upon us; Adonoy, act for the sake of Your name. Act for the sake of Your truth; act for the sake of Your covenant; act for the sake of Your greatness and glory; act for the sake of Your law; act for the sake of Your splendor; act for the sake of Your appointed times; act for the sake of Your remembrance; act for the sake of Your kindness; act for the sake of Your goodness; act for the sake of Your oneness; act for the sake of Your honor; act for the sake of Your teaching; act for the sake of Your kingship; act for the sake of Your eternity; act for the sake of Your secret; act for the sake of Your strength; act for the sake of Your beauty; act for the sake of Your righteousness; act for the sake of Your holiness; act for the sake of Your abundant compassion; act for the sake of Your Presence; act for the sake of Your praise; act for the sake of those who love You and lie in the dust; act for the sake of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; act for the sake of Moses and Aaron; act for the sake of David and Solomon; act for the sake of Jerusalem, Your holy city; act for the sake of Zion, the dwelling place of Your glory; act for the sake of the desolation of Your Sanctuary; act for the sake of the ruins of Your altar; act for the sake of those killed for Your holy name; act for the sake of those slaughtered for Your oneness; act for the sake of those who went through fire and water for the sanctification of Your name; act for the sake of nursing infants who did not sin; act for the sake of weaned children who did not transgress; act for the sake of schoolchildren; act for Your own sake, if not for ours; act for Your own sake and save us.

Answer us, Adonoy, answer us. Answer us, our God, answer us. Answer us, our Father, answer us. Answer us, our Creator, answer us. Answer us, our Redeemer, answer us. Answer us, You who seek us out, answer us. Answer us, faithful God, answer us. Answer us, ancient and faithful One, answer us. Answer us, pure and upright One, answer us. Answer us, living and enduring One, answer us. Answer us, good One who does good, answer us. Answer us, You who know our inclination, answer us. Answer us, You who suppress anger, answer us. Answer us, You who are clothed in righteousness, answer us. Answer us, King, King of kings, answer us. Answer us, awesome and exalted One, answer us. Answer us, You who forgive and pardon, answer us. Answer us, You who answer in time of trouble, answer us. Answer us, You who redeem and rescue, answer us. Answer us, righteous and upright One, answer us. Answer us, You who are near to those who call upon You, answer us. Answer us, compassionate and gracious One, answer us. Answer us, You who hear the needy, answer us. Answer us, You who support the wholehearted, answer us. Answer us, God of our fathers, answer us. Answer us, God of Abraham, answer us. Answer us, Awe of Isaac, answer us. Answer us, Mighty One of Jacob, answer us. Answer us, Help of the tribes, answer us. Answer us, Refuge of the mothers, answer us. Answer us, You who are slow to anger, answer us. Answer us, You who are easily appeased, answer us. Answer us, You who answer in a time of favor, answer us. Answer us, Father of orphans, answer us. Answer us, Judge of widows, answer us.

He who answered our father Abraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer us. He who answered Isaac his son when he was bound upon the altar, He will answer us. He who answered Jacob at Bethel, He will answer us. He who answered Joseph in the prison, He will answer us. He who answered our fathers at the Red Sea, He will answer us. He who answered Moses at Horeb, He will answer us. He who answered Aaron with the fire-pan, He will answer us. He who answered Phinehas when he rose up from the midst of the congregation, He will answer us. He who answered Joshua at Gilgal, He will answer us. He who answered Samuel at Mizpah, He will answer us. He who answered David and Solomon his son in Jerusalem, He will answer us. He who answered Elijah on Mount Carmel, He will answer us. He who answered Elisha in Jericho, He will answer us. He who answered Jonah in the belly of the fish, He will answer us. He who answered Hezekiah, king of Judah, in his illness, He will answer us. He who answered Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah in the midst of the fiery furnace, He will answer us. He who answered Daniel in the lions’ den, He will answer us. He who answered Mordecai and Esther in Shushan the capital, He will answer us. He who answered Ezra in the exile, He will answer us. He who answered all the righteous, the pious, the wholehearted and the upright, He will answer us.

Compassionate One, who answers the poor, answer us. Compassionate One, who answers the broken-hearted, answer us. Compassionate One, who answers the crushed in spirit, answer us. Compassionate One, answer us. Compassionate One, have pity. Compassionate One, redeem. Compassionate One, rescue. Compassionate One, have mercy on us, now, speedily and soon.

segs.text: סליחות לתחלואי ילדים ר"ל
אַל נָא תָשֵׁת עָלֵינוּ חַטָּאת. אֲשֶׁר נוֹאַלְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ: חָטָאנוּ צוּרֵנוּ סְלַח לָנוּ יוֹצְרֵנוּ:

parts.text: אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא תַּחֲלוּאֵי גֶפֶן פּוֹרִיָּה. בּוֹשָׁה וַחֲפוּרָה וְאֻמְלַל פִּרְיָהּ. גְּאָלֶנָּה מִשַּׁחַת וּמִמַּכָּה טְרִיָּה. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה.
דִּגְלֵי עָם פְּדוּיֵי בִּזְרוֹעַ חָשׂוּף. הַצֵּל מִנֶּגֶף וְאַל יִהְיוּ לְשִׁסּוּף. וְתַעֲנֶה קְרִיאָתֵנוּ לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ תִּכְסוֹף. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ עַל יַם סוּף.
זְכוּת צוּר חֻצַּב הַיּוֹם לָנוּ תְגַל. חָשְׂכֵנוּ מֵאֶנֶף וּנְחֵנוּ בְּיוֹשֶׁר מַעְגָּל. טַהֵר טֻמְאָתֵנוּ וְלִמְאוֹר תּוֹרָתְךָ עֵינֵינוּ גַל. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל.
יָהּ רְאֵה דֶשֶׁן עָקוּד וְהַצְמַח לָנוּ תְרוּפָה. כַּלֵּה שׁוֹד וָשֶׁבֶר סַעַר וְסוּפָה. לַמְּדֵנוּ וְחַכְּמֵנוּ אִמְרָתְךָ הַצְּרוּפָה. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לִשְׁמוּאֵל בַּמִּצְפָּה.
מוּתְמָם מֵרֶחֶם שָׁרָשָׁיו אַל תַּקְמֵל. נַקֵּנוּ מִכֶּתֶם וְשֶׁמֶץ וְלֹא נֵאָמֵל. סְעָדֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה וְאָרְחוֹת חֲסָדֶיךָ נִגָּמֵל. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לְאֵלִיָּהוּ בְּהַר הַכַּרְמֶל.

עוֹדְדֵנוּ בְּצֶדֶק מָשׁוּי מִמַּיִם וְכַפֵּר זָדוֹן וּמְשׁוּגָה. פְּדֵנוּ מִמְּהוּמַת מָוֶת וְאָחוֹר בַּל נָסּוֹגָה. צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וּבַעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ אַל נִתְמוֹגְגָה. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לְיוֹנָה בִּמְעֵי הַדָּגָה.

קְדֻשַּׁת אִישׁ חֲסִידֶךָ זְכוֹר לִיפַת פַּעֲמַיִם. רַחֲמֶיךָ תְּעוֹרֵר כִּי לֻקִּינוּ בְּכִפְלַיִם. שׁוּבֵנוּ תֹּקֶף לְיִרְאָתֶךָ וְלֹא נֵחָשֵׂף שׁוּלַיִם. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לְדָוִד וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם.

segs.text: יש שמוסיפים את זה רק בתענית אסתר:

parts.text: תַּעֲנֶה לְקוֹרְאֶיךָ וְהַסְכֵּת מִמְּעוֹנִים. תִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעַת צוֹעֲקֶיךָ. שׁוֹמֵעַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִים. תְּרַחֵם עַל בָּנֶיךָ כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים. עֲנֵנוּ כְּשֶׁעָנִיתָ לְמָרְדְּכַי וְאֶסְתֵּר. וְתָלוּ עַל הָעֵץ חֲמִשִׁים הָאָב עִם הַבָּנִים.

segs.text: Please do not lay sin upon us, in which we have been foolish and in which we have sinned. We have sinned, our Rock; forgive us, our Maker.

God, please heal, please, the ailments of the fruitful vine, ashamed and humiliated, her fruit wretched. Redeem her from the pit and from the fresh wound. Answer us as You answered Abraham our father on Mount Moriah. We have sinned. The banners of the people, redeemed with an outstretched arm — save them from plague, and let them not be plundered. Answer our call; You long for the work of Your hands. Answer us as You answered our fathers at the Red Sea. We have sinned. The merit of the Rock from which we were hewn — let it rejoice us today. Hold us back from Your anger and lead us on the straight path. Purify our impurity, and open our eyes to the light of Your Torah. Answer us as You answered Joshua at Gilgal. We have sinned. Yah, look upon the ashes of the bound one and make healing sprout for us. End plunder and ruin, storm and tempest. Teach us and make us wise in Your refined word. Answer us as You answered Samuel at Mizpah. We have sinned. Let not the one who was perfect from the womb be withered at its roots. Cleanse us of stain and trace of sin, that we not wither. Sustain us, that we may be saved, and let us be nurtured on the paths of Your kindness. Answer us as You answered Elijah on Mount Carmel. We have sinned. Support us in righteousness, You who drew [Moses] from the water, and atone for willful and inadvertent sin. Redeem us from the tumult of death, and let us not turn back. Command our salvation, and let us not melt away through our sins. Answer us as You answered Jonah in the belly of the fish. We have sinned. Remember the holiness of Your pious man, fair of step. Stir Your mercies, for we have been struck doubly. Return us with strength to the fear of You, that we not be uncovered at the hem. Answer us as You answered David and Solomon his son in Jerusalem. We have sinned.

Answer those who call to You and listen from Your dwellings; hear the cry of those who shout to You, You who listen to the needy. Have mercy on Your children as a father has mercy on children. Answer us as You answered Mordechai and Esther, when the father and the sons were hanged on the gallows, fifty cubits high. We have sinned.
